children: Cardiff Oncology resolved its dispute with Nerviano Medical Sciences through a confidential settlement and simultaneously amended their onvansertib license. The settlement provides for dismissal of the litigation with prejudice, mutual releases, and no admission of liability or monetary payments, removing legal overhang on the program. The amended license introduces stronger exclusivity, sales-based supplemental license fees when practicing Company patent claims, Phase 3 milestones and potential performance-related payments, revised post-termination royalties, assignment proceeds sharing before Phase 3 readout, additional governance including a board observer and SAB seat for Nerviano, and a requirement for judicial or arbitral findings before termination for cause. The amendment becomes effective upon dismissal of the litigation.
